evidence: Electron Probe MicroAnalyser (EPMA) with a Wavelength Dispersive X-ray Spectroscopy (WDS) was performed to quantify Zr and Ge concentration. Rutherford Backscattering Spectrometry (RBS) were carried out to quantify tantalum. Grazing Incidence X-Ray Diffraction (GIXRD) measurements with a Cu K α X-ray source were carried out to determine the effect of Ta and Ge incorporation with regard to crystalline structure.
